headline: Trump prepares to raise tariffs on China, the EU and other countries over industrial overcapacity
summary: The US is preparing to raise tariffs on China, the European Union and 14 other jurisdictions to address industrial overcapacity, according to sources cited by The Wall Street Journal. Subsidies to domestic firms are said to hurt US competitors.
why: Tariffs change the cost of traded goods and can reshape global supply chains, trade flows and corporate margins across exporting economies.
why_moved: The report says the US is preparing to raise tariffs on China and the EU, citing industrial overcapacity and subsidies that hurt US competitors.
original_headline: Trump prepara subida de aranceles a China, la UE y otros países por exceso de capacidad industrial
